description: Machine-readable defaults for FOIA / public-records eDiscovery cases created by GwinnIQ. Used by scripts/2-create-foia-case.ps1 and src/gwinniq_ediscovery.py. Contains no tenant-specific or identifying values.

rules: requestNumber is the intake tracking number, zero-padded to 5 digits.
shortSubject is lowercase kebab-case, max 40 characters, no personal names.
iteration starts at 01 and increments for each refinement of the same request.

defaults.descriptionTemplate: Public-records request {requestNumber}. Received {receivedDate}. Statutory response due {dueDate}. Requested date range {rangeStart} to {rangeEnd}.

dataSourceScopeOptions.description: No tenant-wide scope. Sources are attached explicitly. Narrowest and preferred default.
All mailboxes in the tenant. Tenant-wide: requires explicit reviewer acknowledgement.
All SharePoint and OneDrive sites in the tenant. Tenant-wide: requires explicit reviewer acknowledgement.
All custodians already added to the case.
All non-custodial data sources already added to the case.

notes: Always bound a FOIA search by the requested date range.
Prefer explicit keyword lists over broad wildcards to keep the estimate meaningful.

reviewSettings.note: These values are recorded here for the FOIA team's own reference and for later manual configuration in the Purview portal. GwinnIQ does NOT apply them: near-duplicate detection, ignore-text rules, and review tags are all outside the v1 tool scope.
ignoreText: This message originated outside the organization.
CONFIDENTIALITY NOTICE: This email and any attachments are for the sole use of the intended recipient.
Please consider the environment before printing this email.
